An '''IT-O 26 Interrogation Droid''' was a model of [[Interrogation droid/Legends|interrogation droid]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Grendreef/Legends|Grendreef]] ordered the use of an IT-O 26 on a captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] member caught aboard the [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 frigate]] ''[[Handree]]''.
